scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the hero section prominently displays the product name, tagline, and primary calls-to-action as specified in REQ-1 and Story 1

steps.description: Navigate to the MirDB homepage URL
steps.context: Fresh page load with cleared cache

steps.description: Check that 'MirDB' is displayed prominently in the hero section within the first viewport
steps.context: Hero section should be immediately visible without scrolling

steps.description: Confirm the tagline emphasizes persistence with memcached compatibility
steps.context: Tagline should clearly communicate the value proposition

steps.description: Check presence of primary CTA (Get Started/View Documentation) and secondary CTA (View on GitHub)
steps.context: CTAs should be visible and clickable

test_cases.input: Load homepage and inspect hero section
test_cases.expected: Product name 'MirDB' is visible in h1 or prominent heading element
Tagline mentions both 'persistence' and 'memcached' compatibility
Button with text 'Get Started' or 'View Documentation' is present and clickable
Button or link with 'GitHub' reference is present

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that key product features are presented clearly as specified in REQ-2, including persistence, memcached compatibility, and LSM tree architecture

steps.description: Scroll to or locate the features section on the homepage
steps.context: Features section should be accessible via scroll or navigation

steps.description: Check that memcached protocol compatibility is listed as a feature
steps.context: Should mention working with existing memcached clients

steps.description: Check that persistent storage with SSTables is highlighted
steps.context: Should differentiate from standard memcached

steps.description: Check that LSM tree architecture is mentioned
steps.context: Should include technical details about storage approach

steps.description: Check that Tokio-based async I/O is mentioned
steps.context: Performance feature should be highlighted

test_cases.input: Check features section for memcached compatibility
test_cases.expected: Feature mentioning 'memcached protocol' or 'memcached compatible' is present
Feature mentioning 'persistent' or 'persistence' and 'SSTable' is present

test_cases.input: Check features section for LSM tree
test_cases.expected: Feature mentioning 'LSM tree' or 'Log-Structured Merge' is present

test_cases.input: Verify at least 3 key features are displayed
test_cases.expected: Minimum of 3 distinct feature items are visible in the features section
